_comment: Per-fuel carbon intensity (gCO2eq/kWh), used to turn an EIA fuel-generation mix into a weighted grid carbon intensity. Order-of-magnitude lifecycle-style figures consistent with public literature (IPCC AR5 medians etc.). DIRECTIONAL estimates, not audited factors. Keys are EIA fueltype codes.
_source: IPCC AR5 lifecycle emissions medians (approx), rounded. Replace with cited values before any non-directional use.
_comment_canada: Maps Canadian operators' published source categories to the same per-fuel factors above. hq = Hydro-Québec open data (hydraulique/eolien/solaire/thermique/autres; Québec thermal is mostly oil/diesel, 'autres' is biomass/biogas/small hydro). ieso = Ontario IESO fuel types.
_comment_entsoe: Maps ENTSO-E A75 psrType codes to the same per-fuel factors above, so the EU source reuses one emission-factor table. B-codes per ENTSO-E standard.
